system.text:
Characters with Domineering Presence may, once per scene, make their verbal maneuver first in a Duel of Wits. In the case of a Rebuttal versus Point (or something similar), this trait doesn’t have any effect. But if a Bishop is attempting to Dismiss while his opponent is making a Point, then the Bishop player makes his point and rolls his dice first. If he fails to win the Duel, then the other player may respond.

Type: Dt (die trait). Unpriced: costs 1 pt as a lifepath trait.

Restrictions: Human lifepath trait

Source: Burning Wheel Gold Revised, p. 322
